description: This file implements a JSON encoder and decoder class (Services_JSON) with associated constants and error handling classes, providing functionality for converting data to and from JSON format in PHP.

classes.name: Services_JSON
classes.description: A class providing methods to encode PHP variables into JSON strings and decode JSON strings into PHP variables, with configurable error handling and type options.

classes.name: Services_JSON_Error
classes.description: Error class used for representing errors within the Services_JSON class, extending PEAR_Error if available.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for Services_JSON, initializes behavior flags.

methods.name: utf162utf8
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 character to UTF-8, using mb_convert_encoding if available.

methods.name: utf82utf16
methods.description: Converts a UTF-8 character to UTF-16, using mb_convert_encoding if available.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a PHP variable into a JSON string.

methods.name: name_value
methods.description: Generates a JSON name-value pair from a key and value.

methods.name: reduce_string
methods.description: Removes comments and whitespace from a JSON string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a PHP variable.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if a given data is a Services_JSON error.
